name: app-yellow-course-card-phone-balanced-on-rock
title: Course App Phone Balanced on Rock
whatItIs: A tall dark poster with a phone showing a black learning app with a big yellow course card balanced on a grey rock, and a text section below introducing the platform with a yellow graduation-cap icon inline.
whatItMeans: Balancing on rock signals stability and craft, and yellow on black reads as smart and energetic.
techniques: Phone balanced on a rough stone for contrast with sleek UI
Yellow card as the only warm colour on black
Inline icon inside a paragraph as a visual break
Gradient from dark grey to black for depth
Two-column small print below the hero

vocabulary.definition: A small icon placed within a line of text.
A rock used as a display base.
A single warm hue set against a black scheme.
